Resolves #21688

The door-hover test in `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` now waits for the doors' heading before it looks up the home container, as the spec's other three tests do. `#/home` mounts lazily, and the test used to query right after connecting, so on a slow start `home` was null and `home.id` threw (CI: `e2e-engine (13/15)` on #21677, run `44841116207`).

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e, the same loaded repeat on `dev` and at head) → L3 required (a race in a browser test). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 the wait before the first `queryOne` | The diff: one line, the spec's own heading wait |
| AC-2 passes repeated under load | Outside CI: Test Evidence below |
| AC-3 no fixed sleep | The diff |
